title: Judge: compliant versus violating prose pairs
question: How well do the pico and mini judge tiers rank the compliant text above the violating text in matched pairs (AUC, pair accuracy)?

verdict.label: descriptive
verdict.text: AUC per tier and subset; no preregistered decision rule

notes: The date is the recording date; the source files carry no run date.
R1 is no filler or hedging, R2 is short declarative sentences, R3 is concrete words; EN and PL are the language subsets.
